popup.title: Gun Nut House: SMS-01
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Go up the stairs to get the break-in prompt. The SMS-01 sniper rifle is in a gun case on the kitchen table. The house holds six weapons in all: the AR the gun nut carries, the sniper, a rocket launcher, an MG and two revolvers.

popup.title: Kingfishers Laird 350 (Legendary Sniper Rifle)
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
